correctness.rationale: Every deletion step from P^m toward P^k requires the number retained so far to be divisible by q. This forces q-letter retained blocks to be cyclic rotations. Deletions between retained blocks realize their offsets exactly when the minimal sum of modular phase increments q*d does not exceed qk. The minimum is exactly q times the terminally augmented descent count by telescoping. The q-by-q transition matrix captures all rotation sequences; elementary row subtraction computes its characteristic determinant and a cofactor, giving the rational generating function and exact binomial coefficient extraction. Empty complement and zero deletions are included. A separate dynamic oracle matched every predicted complement set on 117 parameter cases, with 4480 independent transfer-count comparisons; finite checks corroborate the general proof rather than prove it.

originality.rationale: The foundational March 21, 2026 primary paper defines complement scattered factors and supplies generic dynamic programming and singleton-complement/shuffle theorems, but its inspected Sections 2–4 do not characterize the complements of nested powers of a fixed distinct-letter permutation. The present result identifies every output by its cyclic rotation indices, proves an exact descent cutoff, and derives a closed uniform enumeration. This is not implied by general enumeration complexity. A 2023 open-access cyclic shuffle-algebra paper studies distributions on shuffles of distinct-letter permutations, not deletion complements of repeated words. Similarity and published-record searches for periodized complements, aliases, and descent formulations found no directly dominating claim; failure to find a result does not establish absolute priority. Abstract Eulerian counting identities are recognized as non-novel without the string interpretation.
residual_risks: An unindexed result on shuffles of periodic identical-letter words could express an equivalent terminal-descent classification under different terminology.
The generalized Eulerian coefficient identity may be independently recorded; uniqueness is claimed only for the exact complement-image interpretation on the evidence reviewed.

value.rationale: Complement scattered factors are a newly studied string observable with potentially many embeddings and exponential output enumeration. This complete infinite parametric family provides a non-obvious exact structural membership criterion and a closed output-cardinality formula for all alphabet sizes and nested whole powers; it resolves a natural test family beyond generic algorithms, and reveals sharp dependence on a cyclic descent budget. It does not merely recompute a known table or assert an unmotivated small finite invariant. Limits to whole-power deletions and absence of embedding multiplicities are explicit.
